title: Children Law Paralegal - Milton Keynes
description:
Role: Children Paralegal / Caseworker

Duncan Lewis Solicitors is seeking a motivated and talented Child Care Paralegal to join our highly regarded Child Care Department. This is an excellent opportunity to develop your career with one of the UK's leading law firms, recognised by The Legal 500 and Chambers & Partners as a top-tier practice and awarded Law Firm of the Year at both the 2024 LexisNexis Awards and the 2023 Modern Law Awards.

Founded in 1998 and headquartered in the City of London, Duncan Lewis Solicitors is a national, award-winning, paperless law firm with over 500 professionals nationwide. Our ethos is simple: "We give people a voice."

Our highly specialised Child Care Department is recognised by The Legal 500 as "an extremely knowledgeable and hugely capable child care team" and is ranked for its expertise across all aspects of child care law. The team represents children, parents, guardians and family members in a broad range of matters, including care proceedings, adoption, surrogacy, co-parenting arrangements and international child issues. The department is distinguished by its exceptional accreditations, with many team members holding Law Society Children Panel membership and membership of the Association of Lawyers for Children, and Duncan Lewis being one of the few firms in the UK on the Lord Chancellor's International Child Abduction and Contact Unit (ICACU) referral list.

Joining Duncan Lewis means becoming part of a diverse, supportive and forward-thinking organisation where you will have the opportunity to work alongside highly regarded specialists on complex and often high-profile cases that make a real difference to children and families.

Duties and responsibilities

As a Children Law Paralegal, you will play a key role in supporting clients across a broad range of child care matters, assisting children, parents, guardians and family members through complex and often sensitive proceedings while helping to achieve the best possible outcomes for those involved.

Key responsibilities will include:
- Report directly to Department Director
- Professional pro-active approach, strong client care skills and a sensitive and sympathetic understanding of clients' needs
- Assisting with casework including dealing with a range of public and private children cases including child abduction; child protection issues; special guardianship and adoption matters as well as undertaking your own advocacy
- Attending clients, taking instructions and preparing cases
- Dealing with correspondence
- Maintaining accurate time costing procedures
- Implementing any recommendations made by your supervisor following monthly file reviews ensuring that these are dealt with promptly
- Ensuring compliance with file management

Experience and qualifications

The successful candidate will demonstrate a genuine interest in Children Law and a commitment to delivering exceptional client service.

Essential requirements include:
- A strong academic background with a Law degree
- Demonstrate passion and experience in a broad range of publicly funded Child Care Law
- Legal experience as a Child Care Paralegal/Advisor
- Clear understanding and application of Children Laws
- Excellent legal research, drafting and analytical skills.
- Strong organisational and time management abilities.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
- Professional, motivated and client-focused approach.
- Business acumen and the ability to market the Company
- Excellent communications skills to work effectively with all types of people
- Excellent analytical and organisational skills and ability to use own initiative but know when to seek guidance
- Strong IT skills, including Microsoft Office and document management systems.

Benefits

We offer a competitive salary and a comprehensive range of benefits designed to support your professional development, wellbeing, and work-life balance, including:
- Competitive salary with structured pay review process
- Company pension scheme
- 22 days annual leave, increasing with length of service
- Additional birthday leave
- Occupational sick pay
- Payment of practising certificate and relevant professional membership fees
- Access to extensive e-library resources and training webinars
- Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) and wellbeing support
- Employee referral scheme
- Eye care vouchers
- Enhanced family-friendly benefits
- DBS checks paid by the Company
- Flexible and hybrid working options, including part-time arrangements where appropriate
- Support for solicitor qualification and SQE1 examinations
- Clear career progression opportunities
- Support for industry recognition, awards, and professional profile development
- Company Medical Cash Plan

Subject to eligibility and Company policy.

Company culture

At Duncan Lewis Solicitors, we are passionate about creating an environment where talented professionals can thrive. We are proud of our diverse and inclusive workforce and are committed to providing equal opportunities for all employees.

Our long-standing Investors in People Gold Standard accreditation reflects our commitment to employee development, while our Lexcel, Cyber Essentials Plus and ISO 27001 certifications demonstrate our dedication to excellence, innovation and security.

We invest heavily in the growth of our people through ongoing training, mentoring, clear progression pathways and opportunities to gain industry recognition. Whether you are looking to deepen your expertise, develop leadership skills or advance your career within a nationally recognised law firm, Duncan Lewis provides the platform to help you succeed.

Join a firm where your expertise is valued, your development is supported, and your work makes a genuine difference to the lives of clients across the UK.

title: Conveyancing Paralegal 2
salary_text: £35000 - £42000 per year (socials and free Christmas shut down)
description:
Residential Conveyancing Paralegal Beaconsfield, Buckinghamshire
Office-based
Minimum three years' residential conveyancing experience
Up to 40,000 + Christmas closure
Do you have at least three years' hands-on residential conveyancing experience, and would you like to work in a team where you are known, supported and valued?
Our client is a friendly, professional and growing legal practice based in smart offices on Beaconsfield High Street. Their residential property team is busy, and they are looking for an experienced Conveyancing Paralegal to work closely with their conveyancers and keep sale and purchase files moving from instruction through to post-completion.
The role This is a varied, hands-on role in a close-knit team. Being in the office together means quick answers, real support and colleagues around you, rather than working alone behind a screen. Your responsibilities will include:
- Supporting sale and purchase transactions from instruction to post-completion, including searches, contract packs, enquiries, completion statements, SDLT returns and Land Registry applications
- Opening new matters and carrying out AML, ID and compliance checks
- Keeping clients, estate agents, lenders and the other side updated at every stage
- Maintaining accurate file records on LEAP
- Handling telephone enquiries and client appointments as part of the office team

What you'll need
- At least three years' experience working on residential conveyancing files in a law firm or conveyancing practice
- A sound working knowledge of the whole sale and purchase process
- Strong organisation, accuracy and professional communication skills
- To live within easy reach of Beaconsfield (for example High Wycombe, Gerrards Cross, Amersham, Marlow, Maidenhead, Slough or Uxbridge), as this role is fully office-based

Experience using LEAP would be helpful but is not essential.
What's on offer?
- A salary of up to 40,000, depending on experience
- The office closes between Christmas and New Year, and those days don't come out of your holiday allowance
- Ongoing training and professional development
- A highly professional, friendly team with a strong local reputation
- Regular company social events
- Smart offices on Beaconsfield High Street, close to the station
- Local parking available and support towards qualifications

If you are an experienced residential Conveyancing Paralegal looking for a role where your experience is valued, we would be delighted to hear from you. Please note that this role requires hands-on residential conveyancing experience, and applications without it cannot be considered. When you apply, please let us know where you are based. Please apply with your CV and Better People will be in touch. Better People Ltd is an equal opportunities employer. If you do not hear from one of our consultants within 7 days of applying for this role, please assume you have been unsuccessful in this instance. Your CV will be kept on file and you will be considered for future vacancies that match your skills. By applying you will register as a candidate with Better People Ltd. Our Privacy Policy on our website explains how we will use your information. Our clients are only able to offer employment to candidates who are fully eligible to work in the UK and cannot offer work visas/sponsorship etc.

title: Paralegal - Conveyancing
description:
We are looking for a highly experienced Paralegal - Conveyancing to join a growing, law firm based in Beaconsfield. This is a full-time, permanent, office based role offering a salary of up to 40,000. Client care is at the heart of everything the firm does, with a strong focus on delivering a personal, supportive and high-quality service from the initial enquiry through to the successful completion of each transaction.

Key Accountabilities for Paralegal - Conveyancing:
- Welcome clients, manage reception and meeting rooms, and answer incoming calls
- Manage diaries, appointments, meetings, ID checks and document witnessing
- Handle incoming and outgoing post, scanning, filing and photocopying
- Open new files, prepare initial letters and maintain accurate records on LEAP
- Assist with AML checks and solicitor compliance
- Prepare quotes and support new client enquiries
- Assist with residential conveyancing transactions, including searches, contract packs and redemption statements
- Draft documents, completion statements and correspondence
- Liaise with clients, estate agents and solicitors throughout transactions
- Manage exchange and completion administration, including payments, SDLT submissions and leasehold notices
- Assist with Land Registry registrations, requisitions and outstanding balance audits
- Manage file scheduling, archiving and general office administration
- Any other administration tasks

Key Skills Required for the Paralegal - Conveyancing:
- Strong paralegal conveyancing experience
- High levels of accuracy and attention to detail
- Confident communicator
- High levels of customer care, client first focus
- Solid administration skills
- Highly organised, process driven
- Adaptable in a changing environment

What's in it for you?
- Monday to Friday 9.00 am to 5.00 pm office based
- Working as part of a small, collaborative team
- Close to Beaconsfield train station
- Social events
- Free parking
- Extra holiday for Christmas shutdown

title: PARALEGAL - CRIMINAL
company: Maze Recruitment Services Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
JOB TITLE: PARALEGAL - (CRIMINAL OR REGULATORY DISPUTE RESOLUTION EXPERIENCE)

HOURS OF EMPLOYMENT: 9am - 5:30pm Monday to Friday

BENEFITS: Excellent additional bens

Main Purpose of the role:

A fantastic opportunity has arisen for a Paralegal to join a highly regarded law firm and join its Criminal or Regulatory Dispute Resolution team. This is an excellent opportunity for someone looking to build theirlegal career within a specialist practice, working on a varied range of matters for both private individuals and business clients. The successful candidate will ideally have some experience in Criminal Law, Regulatory Law or Dispute Resolution, together with strong research, drafting and organisational skills.

Main Duties and Responsibilities for the Paralegal role:
- Providing comprehensive Paralegal support to the legal team.
- Assisting Solicitors with a varied caseload of Criminal and Regulatory Dispute Resolution matters.
- Assisting with motoring offences, including speeding, drink/drug driving, careless and dangerous driving and other road traffic matters.
- Providing support with regulatory and dispute resolution matters involving private individuals and business clients.
- Extensiveclient liaison, dealing with general queries by telephone and email on behalf of Solicitors, taking accurate messages and, where possible, dealing with queries appropriately.
- Maintaining regular direct contact with clients bytelephone, email and face-to-face.
- Preparing correspondence, legal documentation, statements, case summaries and other documents as required.
- Preparing Court Bundles and documentation for Solicitors and Counsel.
- Proofreading all documentation and making amendments before documents are passed to the Solicitor.
- Conducting legal research and assisting with case preparation.
- Managing diaries and ensuring all appointments, hearings, deadlines and tasks are accurately diarised.
- Ensuring Solicitors and Partners are kept up to date with important dates and deadlines.
- Ensuring all information held on the firm's database is complete, accurate and up to date.
- Ensuring all relevant documents and enclosures are attached to the correct file before posting or sending.
- Assisting with the opening, closing, archiving and retrieval of files.
- Working effectively under pressure and meeting tight deadlines.
- Maintaining accurate and organised case files throughout the life of each matter.
- Ensuring departmental systems and firm-wide procedures are followed at all times.
- Complying with all relevant legislation, regulations and professional requirements, including client confidentiality, Anti-Money Laundering requirements, SRA and Law Society rules, Solicitors' Accounts Rules and data protection legislation.
- Providing a consistently high standard of client care and professional service.

Person Specification required for the Paralegal role:
- Previous experience working as a Criminal Paralegal or Regulatory/Dispute Resolution Paralegal, or in a similar legal support role.
- Experience of motoring offences would be particularly advantageous.
- Alternatively, experience in Regulatory Dispute Resolution or wider criminal matters.
- Experience dealing with private individuals and/or business clients.
- Good knowledge of legal procedures and case management.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Strong organisational skills and excellent attention to detail.
- Ability to prioritise work, manage deadlines and work effectively under pressure.
- Confident dealing directly with clients and other legal professionals.
- Professional, approachable and client-focused.

Note: This job description is intended to provide a general overview of the position. It is not an exhaustive list of responsibilities or requirements.

Maze Recruitment will never share your CV with any third party without your explicit consent. As part of our candidate care commitment, and due to the high volume of applications we receive, we aim to respond within 24-48 hours. If you do not hear from us in this timeframe, please consider your application unsuccessful on this occasion. We encourage you to apply for future opportunities that align with your skills and interests.

title: Property Secretary
description:
Property Secretary / PA to the Managing Partner

Location: High Wycombe, Buckinghamshire
Salary: 34,000- 37,000 depending on experience
Benefits: Pension following successful completion of probation

The Opportunity

An established and highly regarded law firm is looking to recruit a capable, experienced Property Secretary / PA to the Managing Partner to join its property team.

The firm has a strong reputation for delivering pragmatic, commercially focused legal advice, working with a diverse client base ranging from owner-managed businesses and SMEs to larger corporate clients. Its property practice is predominantly commercial, with additional residential conveyancing work.

This is an excellent opportunity for a confident legal secretary who enjoys taking ownership of their work, supporting senior fee earners and playing an integral role in the smooth running of a busy property practice.

The Role

You will provide high-quality secretarial and administrative support to the Managing Partner and wider property team, with a genuine degree of autonomy and responsibility for the day-to-day management of matters.

Key responsibilities include:
- Preparing, typing and amending legal documents, including using Track Changes.
- Managing electronic and physical files, from opening through to closure.
- Liaising directly with clients and third parties, handling correspondence and drafting emails independently.
- Conducting Land Registry searches and assisting with applications and requisitions.
- Preparing and submitting SDLT returns.
- Supporting property transactions, including commercial property and residential conveyancing matters.
- Managing billing, monitoring monies received and paid, and chasing outstanding invoices.
- Preparing cost schedules and schedules of property searches and associated disbursements.
- Monitoring deadlines, maintaining accurate records and ensuring matters progress efficiently.

About You

We are looking for a genuinely capable property legal secretary who can work independently and confidently support a busy senior fee earner.

You will ideally have:
- Previous experience as a Property Legal Secretary, Legal PA or similar within a private practice law firm.
- A strong working knowledge of commercial property, with residential conveyancing experience also advantageous.
- Experience with Land Registry procedures, searches, applications, requisitions and SDLT returns.
- Confidence managing legal files, preparing documentation and communicating directly with clients.
- Experience with billing, financial administration and monitoring outstanding invoices.
- Excellent organisational skills, accuracy and the ability to manage competing priorities with minimal supervision.
- A proactive, professional approach and the confidence to take ownership of tasks.

What's on Offer?
- 34,000- 37,000 salary, depending on experience.
- Your own private office, providing a dedicated workspace.
- Pension provision following successful completion of probation.
- Direct support to the Managing Partner, offering responsibility and exposure to senior-level work.
- A varied commercial property caseload, alongside some residential conveyancing.
- The opportunity to join an established firm with a strong client-focused and commercially minded approach.

Interested?

If you are an experienced property legal secretary looking for a role offering autonomy, responsibility and the opportunity to work closely with the Managing Partner, we would welcome a confidential conversation.

Search is an equal opportunities recruiter and we welcome applications from all suitably skilled or qualified applicants, regardless of their race, sex, disability, religion/beliefs, sexual orientation or age.

title: Remote Conveyancing Paralegal
company: LEGAL TALENT PARTNERS LIMITED - Agency - Permanent
description:
Remote Conveyancing Paralegal

£30,000-40,000

Quality. Technology. Flexibility. A Better Way to Do Conveyancing.

We're partnering with a fast-growing, forward-thinking residential conveyancing firm that is using technology, smarter processes and a collaborative team structure to change the way property law is delivered.

The firm is built around a simple idea: conveyancing should be simpler, clearer and faster - for clients and the people delivering it.

If you're an experienced conveyancing paralegal looking for greater autonomy, better technology, a sustainable workload and the flexibility of a fully remote role, this could be an excellent next move.

Why This Role Stands Out

This is not a traditional conveyancing environment where paralegals are left to manage overwhelming caseloads with little support.

You'll work within small, collaborative teams, with regular check-ins, structured 1-to-1s, feedback and personalised training.

The firm takes a quality over quantity approach to workload, maintaining sustainable caseloads and giving teams capacity to deal with peaks without compromising client service.

You'll benefit from:
- Sustainable caseloads and a strong focus on work-life balance
- Small, collaborative teams
- Regular support, feedback and development
- Bespoke technology designed around legal teams
- A culture where asking for help is encouraged
- The opportunity to influence how technology and processes develop
- Fully remote working with genuine flexibility

The result? A more manageable workload, better support and the freedom to focus on delivering excellent conveyancing rather than simply processing as many files as possible.

The Role

As a Conveyancing Paralegal, you'll be an integral part of a residential conveyancing team, working alongside lawyers and other paralegals to deliver an excellent client service.

You'll work across freehold and leasehold sales, purchases and remortgages, taking ownership of your matters while working collaboratively with the wider team.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Progressing residential sales, purchases and remortgages
- Handling freehold sales with minimal supervision
- Managing most leasehold sale enquiries with minimal supervision
- Managing most freehold purchase enquiries with minimal supervision
- Liaising with clients, solicitors, estate agents and other third parties
- Proactively identifying issues and keeping transactions moving
- Reviewing and responding to enquiries
- Maintaining clear, jargon-free communication
- Using the firm's technology to manage your caseload efficiently
- Identifying and resolving potential issues before they become blockers
- Providing feedback to improve systems and processes

The firm's technology has been developed specifically around its conveyancing process, and legal professionals are encouraged to provide feedback on the tools they use every day.

About you

You'll ideally have:
- Strong experience in residential conveyancing
- Experience handling freehold sales with limited supervision
- Experience dealing with leasehold sale enquiries
- Experience dealing with freehold purchase enquiries
- Confidence communicating with clients and third parties
- A proactive approach to progressing transactions
- Strong organisation and attention to detail
- Excellent communication and problem-solving skills
- Confidence working independently in a remote environment
- An interest in using technology to improve legal work

You don't need to be qualified. This role is suited to an experienced paralegal with strong technical conveyancing skills who is ready to take greater ownership of their work.

Although fully remote, you won't be left alone with a laptop and a pile of files. Regular team check-ins, 1-to-1s and ongoing feedback are built into the firm's approach.

The Culture:

This is a firm deliberately doing things differently.

Rather than chasing maximum utilisation, it takes a sustainable approach to workload, helping teams maintain consistent service levels while giving people room to deal with the unexpected.

Its technology helps allocate work, streamline processes and keep teams informed, while its remote-working model is built around communication, supervision, feedback and development.

There's also a strong culture of transparency and continuous improvement. People are encouraged to share ideas, challenge processes and help shape the future of the business.

The Package
- £30,000-£40,000 depending on experience
- Fully remote - work from anywhere in the UK
- Flexible working hours
- 25 days' holiday + 3 days at Christmas + Bank Holidays
- Full home-working setup and equipment provided
- Comprehensive private healthcare
- Free access to Spill mental health and wellbeing support
- Company pension scheme
- Enhanced maternity, paternity and adoption leave
- Growth Shares, giving employees an opportunity to share in the long-term success of the business
- Fully paid-for annual company weekend
- Structured development and genuine progression opportunities

The firm's flexible approach is a key part of its culture, with many employees working flexible hours or part-time. The focus is on creating working patterns that work for both the individual and the wider team.

If you're an experienced conveyancing paralegal looking for a genuinely modern, supportive and flexible place to build your career, we'd love to hear from you.
